title: Absence is a coverage-dependent classification, not a search result

observed: The canonical queue keeps M-004, M-005, and M-006 unresolved until exhaustive branch or equivalent repository-history coverage is obtained.
CM-0024 defines a manifest contract for refs, tags, reachable commits, trees, blobs, exclusions, traversal errors, completion state, and retained digests.
The current connector-visible repository searches and File Library suffix matches do not satisfy that contract.
inferred: A zero-result search describes the output of one retrieval method; it does not establish repository-wide nonexistence.
The status unlocated is therefore a derived classification whose validity depends on retained complete coverage evidence.
proposed: Represent every negative provenance conclusion as a tuple of subject identifier, searched object universe, completion state, exclusions, errors, query bytes, and immutable evidence locators.
Allow unresolved to transition to unlocated only when the coverage tuple is complete and independently auditable.
superseded: Treating search-result absence as equivalent to historical absence.
Treating identifier suffix similarity as sufficient provenance resolution.
unresolved: Immutable provenance and originating source for M-004.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-005.
Immutable provenance and originating source for M-006.
Execution and retained verification of the exhaustive traversal defined by CM-0024.

required_conditions: coverage_manifest.excluded_objects is empty or every exclusion is explicitly accepted
exact namespace-qualified queries were retained as UTF-8 bytes
raw traversal output and manifest digests are retained
no immutable namespace-qualified match exists in the covered object universe
forbidden_shortcuts: automation completion prose without immutable source object

falsification_route: Produce an immutable source object that explicitly assigns M-004, M-005, or M-006 in the continuity namespace, or show that a zero-result partial search can soundly establish absence without a defined and retained object universe.
next_action: Implement the CM-0024 manifest producer and retain a complete traversal before changing any unresolved M-series provenance node to unlocated.
